cases.name: Ada Lovelace
cases.birthQuality: B; time quoted from a biography and correspondence, at a round hour; approximate London longitude.

career.headline: The strong rules disagree. A steady, respected profession with authority over others; yet breaks and restarts in the career line. Read both before deciding.

key.text: Saturn dignified: a steady, respected profession with authority over others.
Karma with Ketu: technical, computing, healing or research work; breaks and restarts in the career line.
Jupiter, Venus and Mercury linked by sign (not necessarily in the same sign): refined intellect; advisor, teacher, financier or artist; pleasant speech wins support.

children.headline: Venus stands in the same sign as Jupiter, the putra karaka. This tradition treats the connection as prominent when discussing children; it cannot establish whether or when someone has children.

key.text: Jupiter with Venus in one sign: a Jupiter–Venus connection that this Nadi tradition considers relevant to children; it does not establish whether, how or when someone has children.
Jupiter with or in trine to Rahu: some Nadi readers consider Rahu a factor in family circumstances; the connection cannot identify a route to parenthood or a child's future.
Rahu with or in trine to Venus: a traditional family-related combination; it cannot assess conception or a child's health.
